topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I just found out about the lies. All this time, I thought we had a solid bond, something real. Turns out, my so-called friend was spinning yarns about his job, making himself sound more important than he is. How could he sit there and pretend, week after week, knowing I believed every word? Now, I’m left wondering what else is a lie. Did he think I’d be impressed? Well, I’m not. I’m done with the charades. If he can’t be honest, there's no point in keeping this farce of a friendship going.
